bear_assumptions: USD 13 normalized forward diluted EPS at 22x as customer fab spending slows, tighter export controls constrain China, concentration and working-capital absorption pressure cash conversion, and the premium multiple compresses.
base_assumptions: USD 16 normalized forward diluted EPS at 28x as fiscal-Q4 guidance broadly converts, leading-edge logic, DRAM, advanced packaging and AGS grow, and margins normalize below the fiscal-Q3 peak.
bull_assumptions: USD 19 normalized forward diluted EPS at 34x as materials intensity, new DRAM and packaging systems, installed-base services and share gains sustain above-cycle revenue growth and operating leverage.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower price or stronger primary-evidence normalized earnings clears expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence, timing and accepted-relationship gates; downgrade if leading-edge or DRAM demand weakens, AGS stalls, margins reverse, cash conversion deteriorates, export restrictions intensify, or customer concentration drives material volatility.
